samples.evidence: A Qualitative Study of Suicide Resiliency Factors for Young Gay Men. Using grounded theory methodology, we explored the suicide resiliency in eight young gay men in Aotearoa/New Zealand. Eight participants (under the age of 26 years) were recruited via youth networks, in response to an invitation to ". . . participate in some research on queer male youth, suicide, and the coming-out process."
